verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's evidence covers renting GPU instances, templates, volumes, and API/CLI access, but nothing describes a distinct sandbox/staging environment or safeguards to prevent an agent from touching 'production' data — the platform is generic compute infrastructure with no documented separation of test vs. production environments. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, isolation guarantees between test and production data, and any documentation framing instances as safe-to-experiment sandboxes.
